svg.title: Chromalect 0.2.0 - 513 component identities
svg.desc: The original 40 stable colors plus 473 newly assigned colors cover 510 distinct transcribed GF 0014 component forms plus three preserved pilot forms. Some source forms are only descriptions, not displayable Unicode glyphs.
svg.text: 0.2.0 · 513 identity colors · 514 GF records · 441 GF groups · descriptive forms marked IDS
